ground_truth_root_cause: The external shipping rate API provider (api.shippingrates.io) is experiencing DNS infrastructure degradation: all DNS queries to the shippingrates.io zone are timing out after ~7 seconds regardless of retry attempt. This is confirmed by 100% timeout rate across 31+ consecutive DNS resolution attempts while all other external hostnames (api.stripe.com, google.com) resolve normally in <15ms. The checkout-service itself is healthy; the fault is entirely in the upstream DNS infrastructure of the shippingrates.io domain. No recent checkout-service deploy is responsible — the most recent relevant deploy (52a8a76cf862) only bumped mix production dependencies in the shipping-adapter and does not affect DNS resolution logic.
ground_truth_remediation: 1. Immediately contact shippingrates.io support/status page to report and track the DNS outage. 2. Enable the pre-configured fallback shipping provider (api.fallback-shipping.io) in the shipping-adapter configuration to restore checkout order flow within minutes. 3. If fallback provider requires credentials, retrieve from secrets manager and apply via config update or environment variable injection — no code deploy required. 4. Reset the circuit breaker after fallback is confirmed working by restarting the shipping-adapter or triggering a manual circuit breaker reset via the admin API. 5. Monitor error rate and p99 latency recovery. 6. Once shippingrates.io DNS is restored, validate connectivity and switch back from fallback provider during a low-traffic window.
